dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: #Oh me, oh my, if it isn't {NICKNAME} and Paimon? Fancy meeting you here — my luck must be turning, I just know it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Dori? What are you doing here all alone? Planning to set up shop? ... Hmm, don't see you carrying any goods, though...

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Ah, my sincerest apologies, but the renowned traveling merchant Dori is taking the day off.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: You can say I'm taking a page out of the locals' books and enjoying a normal, carefree day in this Elysium we call Nod-Krai!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Seriously? You, not busy making Mora? Next you'll say it's been raining all year in the desert...

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Hehe, I'll tell you what — even if I myself take a break, my assiduous, adept employees are still constantly growing our revenue streams!

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: So there's nothing to worry about — so long as the account numbers go up, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Speaking of that... Might you two be having some trouble? I might be on vacation, but far be it from me to reject any business that comes knocking at my door.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Ahh, so you're here to take pictures of Nod-Krai's unique scenery, hmm? Well, then, you've come to the right person!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: I know this place like the back of my hand — not quite as well as the locals, certainly, but if it's recommendations you need, I have them right here!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: And since we're friends, I'll personally serve as your guide, with a hefty friend discount to boot. Soooo... how does 500,000 Mora a day sound, mmm?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, that's Dori for you. Never a few phrases away from helping yourself to the Mora in our pockets.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Oh no, no, I'm doing this so that you, my dear valued customers, can have a lovely, wonderful, unforgettable time here in Nod-Krai!

choices.text: Well, if you're so passionate about helping us out...

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Hmm? An interesting idea, to be sure. But mind you, such photos can't be used in for-profit advertisements. The rights to my likeness are most valuable, I'll have you know!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, don't worry, it's just a photo of an old friend — y'know, for old times' sake!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: #Ah! Of course, of course! Since it's you who've requested this personally, {NICKNAME}, I'll make an exception. Just one — and make sure I look splendid, that's all I ask!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Let me think... How's "Dori, Lord Sangemah Bay, and Her Paradise Vacation" sound for a caption? Brilliant, no?

choices.text: Could we take a picture of you?
And looking for some photo-op material while we're at it.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: How's it going? Have you figured out the best angle from which to immortalize my eminent aspect?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're good. Let the photo-op begin!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: One moment. The inspiration's not quite coming yet...

dialogues.speaker: Dori

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Ahh, so you're here to take pictures of Nod-Krai's unique scenery, hmm?

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Well, then, you've come to the right person! Beautiful memories are priceless treasures. Though, of course, converting these memories into a best-selling album would make them more valuable still, hehe!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: That said, I don't see you carrying a Kamera — in which case, might I interest you in the newest, most high-end models of such?

choices.text: And looking for some photo-op material while we're at it.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Well, then! Found photo-taking material that inspires and excites? If not, I could recommend you a few spots.

choices.text: We're good. Let the photo-op begin!
